title: 1-1-prep-ethan-wong
body:
1:1 prep with Lina Morales (engineering manager) - Ethan Wong
Date: 2026-03-04 (weekly)
Location: Zoom / async notes

Objectives for this 1:1:
- Quick sync on current priorities and blockers (15m)
- Career growth / mentorship check-in (10m)
- Ask for support (headcount/design review) and alignment on next steps (5m)

Current priorities (talking points):
- Project: Alpha Inference Pipeline (shipping v0.3 autoscaling tweaks)
  - On track: autoscaler config landed on staging; smoke tests passing
  - Metrics: p50 latency ~42ms, cost per token down ~6% on staging runs
  - Remaining: perf regressions under 8k sequence length for some quantized variants - need kernel selection follow-up

- Oncall / incidents:
  - Friday incident: KV cache eviction bug led to ~5min elevated latencies for a subset of dedicated nodes; root cause traced to race in shard rebalancer (PR #412), fix deployed canaryed, monitor for 24-48h
  - Action: propose adding pre-merge integration test that simulates rebalancer concurrency

- Mentorship / team health:
  - Priya ramp: good progress on profiler/instrumentation tasks; still needs clarity on how to interpret kernel-level metrics - pairing session scheduled Thu
  - Hiring: interviewing a mid-level infra engineer next week; need Lina's support on leveling and interview loop slots

Blockers / asks for Lina:
- Request approval to prioritize kernel selection follow-up work (2 engineer-weeks) to address regressions; propose reallocating one SRE to help with perf tests
- Ask for quicker turnaround on headcount approval process for mid-level hire (hiring committee is waiting)
- Need time from Lina for a 45m design review next Wednesday for the autoscaler change (aim to get buy-in before Friday rollout)

Career / growth discussion points:
- Goal reminder: move toward Staff SWE responsibilities by H2 2026 (influence across infra, lead design reviews, mentor ICs)
- Feedback to ask: where should I focus to demonstrate cross-team leadership? Specific asks: opportunities to run a cross-functional postmortem and lead the next oncall runbook overhaul
- Ask Lina for a sponsor to introduce me to product PMs for cross-team roadmap syncs

Notes / questions I want Lina to answer:
- Does leadership prefer shifting priority from feature X to kernel follow-ups now, or maintain feature cadence and fix kernel work later after the v0.3 rollout?
- Any suggestions for framing the headcount ask to the hiring committee (cost vs. velocity arguments)?
- Would Lina be open to me running the next oncall rotation as lead (to show ops ownership)?

Action items (post 1:1):
- [Ethan] Draft a 1-page justification for headcount (due: 2026-03-06) - include cost/benefit, time-to-impact, interview plan
- [Ethan] Create a small perf test job to reproduce 8k seq regression and link to PR #412 (due: 2026-03-05)
- [Priya] Pairing session on kernel metrics interpretation (scheduled: 2026-03-05)
- [Lina] Approve 45m design review slot for autoscaler (requested: 2026-03-06)
- [Lina] Quick decision on prioritization tradeoff (expected: by 2026-03-07)

Misc notes / personal reminders:
- Keep meeting notes concise and add outcomes to JIRA ticket JIRA-RT-5678
- Follow up with SRE about adding integration test for rebalancer race condition
- Bring a short demo snapshot to design review to show observed latency improvements and remaining regression cases

Tone reminders (notes to self):
- Be concise, surface metrics first, then context, then ask
- If Lina pushes back on headcount, be ready with counterfactual (what we delay if we don't hire)
- Ask for explicit next steps and owners at end of meeting

End of 1:1 prep notes.
